headline: European Natural Gas Prices Surge 40% in October Amid U.S.-Iran Military Escalation
summary: European natural gas futures surged 40 percent in October as military escalation between the United States and Iran raised supply disruption concerns.
why: Spikes in European natural gas prices increase operational costs for energy-intensive manufacturing sectors and inflate regional utility costs.

impacts.name: European natural gas futures
impacts.why: Geopolitical military escalation directly restricts energy supply expectations, driving prices higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Military escalation between the U.S. and Iran stoked fears of regional energy supply disruptions, driving a sharp monthly rally in European gas contracts.
